_meta.population: 6 of the 34 codes whose prose asserts national foreign-ownership openness the record denies. These six share one record fact: the bidang usaha is allocated to Koperasi and UMKM by Perpres 49/2021 Lampiran II, so pma_max_asing is 0 — a PT PMA cannot hold it ANYWHERE in Indonesia.
_meta.why_these_six_first: Not the largest group, the most expensive. Four of them (96210, 96220, 96100, 95291) carry a sentence that contradicts ITSELF — 'nationally open to full foreign ownership, but a PT PMA cannot register this activity anywhere in Indonesia'. If it were nationally open to full foreign ownership a PT PMA could hold it; the reservation IS the national position, not something a separate rule then blocks. A reader of the first half goes looking for the structure that unlocks the second. The other two (95220, 95299) are worse: their bodies still tell the whole story as a BALI problem — 'national openness remains real' — which sends a client to register in Jakarta, where it is refused too.
_meta.who_wrote_the_text_being_replaced: 27 of the 31 first-measured contradicting bodies carry _l3_regen.source = LLM_EDITORIAL_GROUNDED, model = deepseek-v4-pro, confidence = LOW. No human authored them. An earlier round of this lane declined to touch them citing Legge 5; that deference was protecting an authorship that does not exist, and Zero withdrew it on 2026-08-06.
_meta.replacement_is_whole_field_not_sentence: A cross-family review refuted the sentence-level version of this cure: 95220's body carries the false premise in four separate places, so patching one leaves the paragraph contradicting itself. Every entry here replaces the WHOLE field. Where a body holds true facts unrelated to ownership — 95299's scope and its exclusion list, 95220's scope paragraph — those paragraphs are carried over VERBATIM by construction, because the previous spec's failure mode was deleting true licensing and zoning facts while fixing an ownership sentence.
_meta.what_is_deliberately_kept: The Bali moratorium on 95220 and 95299 is REAL (l4_bali.blocked = true, sourced to Governor's letter B.27.000/642/PM/DPMPTSP, 13 May 2026) and is kept — demoted from THE reason to a second, independent restriction, with an explicit sentence that relocating to another province lifts only that one. 96220's disambiguation from spa (96230) and fitness is kept verbatim: it is the kind of fact an earlier cure in this directory lost.
_meta.machine_gate: Every replacement is checked before the spec is written: no percentage may appear that differs from the record's pma_max_asing, and re-running the detector over the patched record must report zero remaining openness assertions. Both passed on all 21 fields.
_meta.grading: Every replacement is graded by a cross-family seat instructed to refute what was WRITTEN, not what was removed (W113: a correction is read as the safe part of a diff, and no adversarial round is usually pointed at it).

editorial.body.old_excerpt: A foreign investor cannot obtain PMA registration for this activity in Bali today. That is the decisive local
editorial.body.new:
A foreign investor cannot obtain PMA registration for this activity — and the reason is national, not local. Perpres 10/2021 as amended by 49/2021 allocates this bidang usaha to Koperasi and UMKM in its Lampiran II, which sets the foreign-ownership ceiling at 0% and puts the activity out of reach of a PT PMA anywhere in Indonesia. Bali adds a second, independent restriction on top of that, but moving the registration to another province would not lift the first.

The work itself is practical, broad and firmly rooted in the maintenance economy of everyday life. It covers repair and servicing for household equipment including refrigerators, stoves, washing machines, clothes dryers, air conditioners, electric irons, vacuum cleaners and other electrical household goods. It also includes the repair and maintenance of home-and-garden equipment: lawn mowers, edgers, snow and leaf sweepers, trimmers and related equipment. In clear terms, this is the business of restoring the machines and appliances that keep homes and gardens functioning.

The activity is open to Micro, Small, Medium and Large businesses. That range gives the classification room to accommodate a compact repair operation as well as a larger service business, without changing the basic nature of the registered activity: repair and maintenance of household and home-and-garden equipment. Scale, however, does not change the ownership position: a bidang usaha allocated to Koperasi and UMKM is closed to a PT PMA at every scale.

Bali requires a separate reading, and it is additional rather than decisive. Its status is Blocked (risk class) because the relevant OSS risk assessment at the Large scale is Low or Medium-Low across every scope, and Bali’s permanent, province-wide moratorium blocks all Low and Medium-Low risk KBLI for PMA. The moratorium was identified in the record in May 2026 and is sourced to the Governor’s letter B.27.000/642/PM/DPMPTSP. The practical conclusion is that two restrictions apply at once: the national allocation to Koperasi and UMKM, which no province can lift, and the Bali moratorium on top of it.

editorial.body.old_excerpt: A foreign investor is unable to register this activity in Bali today. That conclusion sits beside a more permi
editorial.body.new:
A foreign investor is unable to register this activity, and the restriction is national before it is local. Perpres 10/2021 as amended by 49/2021 allocates this bidang usaha to Koperasi and UMKM in its Lampiran II, setting the foreign-ownership ceiling at 0% for a PT PMA anywhere in Indonesia. Bali adds a second restriction of its own: every scope at the large-business scale is assessed by OSS as Low or Medium-Low risk, placing the activity within the province-wide, permanent moratorium on PMA registration for those risk bands.

The activity is the practical craft of keeping personal and household possessions in use. Its scope includes repairing and maintaining bicycles, electric bicycles, monowheels, hoverboards and kick scooters; repairing or altering jewellery; and repairing watches, clocks, wall clocks and their components, from straps and cases to movement frames. It also reaches sporting equipment other than sporting guns, books, musical instruments, toys and similar goods, as well as other personal and household articles. Piano tuning and key duplication are expressly within the scope.

Its boundaries matter because this is a repair classification, not a catch-all for every workshop task. It excludes, among other things, metal engraving, repairs to sporting or recreational guns, repairs to powered hand tools, restoration of organs and other historic musical instruments, and repairs to time locks, time-and-date stamps and other time-recording equipment. For a business built around everyday objects rather than industrial equipment, the category is therefore broad in consumer-facing practice while still clearly delimited.

Registration is open across Mikro, Kecil, Menengah and Besar business scales, but scale does not change the ownership position: a bidang usaha allocated to Koperasi and UMKM is closed to a PT PMA at every scale. In Bali the provincial rule adds a further block — all Low and Medium-Low risk KBLI activities are blocked island-wide and permanently, under the Bali moratorium dated May 2026. The honest reading is that two independent restrictions apply, and relocating to another province would lift only the second.
